description: Asks, on a writable copy of Tx, what SQL does when it builds edge strings itself and what is then stored, in sequence, each followed by RecordsAffected and DBEngine.Errors: appending Chr(0), putting a lone high surrogate in front of a value, cutting an astral pair with Left, copying the Memo column to the Text column and back, a 300-character value into Text(255) and into Memo, a 256-character value from Space, StrConv to and from the Unicode form, UCase of U+00DF, Replace to a lone surrogate, and INSERT ... SELECT that doubles values and swaps T and M. After each group the rows (ID, T, LenB(T), M) are read ordered by ID. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: UPDATE Tx SET T = T & Chr(0) WHERE ID IN (1, 2, 12)
UPDATE Tx SET T = ChrW(55296) & T WHERE ID = 13
UPDATE Tx SET T = Left(T, 1) WHERE ID IN (6, 8)
UPDATE Tx SET M = T WHERE T Is Not Null
SELECT ID, T, LenB(T) AS lb, M FROM Tx ORDER BY ID
UPDATE Tx SET T = M WHERE ID = 5
UPDATE Tx SET T = String(300, 'x') WHERE ID = 1

UPDATE Tx SET T = Space(255) & 'a' WHERE ID = 2
UPDATE Tx SET T = Chr(0) & Chr(0) WHERE ID = 3
SELECT ID, T, LenB(T) AS lb, M FROM Tx ORDER BY ID
UPDATE Tx SET T = StrConv(T, 64) WHERE ID = 12
UPDATE Tx SET T = StrConv(StrConv(T, 128), 64) WHERE ID = 4
UPDATE Tx SET T = UCase(T) WHERE ID IN (14, 16)
UPDATE Tx SET T = Replace(T, 'a', ChrW(55357)) WHERE ID = 11
INSERT INTO Tx (ID, T) SELECT ID + 100, T & T FROM Tx WHERE ID < 6
INSERT INTO Tx (ID, T, M) SELECT ID + 200, M, T FROM Tx WHERE ID IN (4, 5, 6, 7)
SELECT ID, T, LenB(T) AS lb, M FROM Tx ORDER BY ID
